Definition: from the base of G1476; a basis (bottom), i.e. the soil:--ground.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this word once, telling how he fell to the ground on the road to Damascus and heard the voice of Jesus asking why he persecuted Him. The ground is the lowest place, and that is where Paul's old life ended and his new one began.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God often brings us to the ground before He lifts us up, because pride has to fall before grace can raise us.
